title: Not the pink rose quarts it shows, not very full looking.
text:
Not the pink rose quarts it shows, not very full looking.. This comes folded up in a box, in a burlap bag. Nice packaging for a gift.

I have been collecting large and small different crystals for years, and these are not what i would consider to be good for Rose Quarts .
My rose quarts tree was not a rose or a pink color. It is more white with a very lite pinkish hue !
The white quartz base where the copper wire is drilled into looks like its been spray with a light green color to look like moss.
Actually does Not look too bad.
I up-graded my tree thinking it would be fuller like the picture showed, that is not what i received.

You have to move the wires with the quarts chips into the right position which i understand, to make this maybe look like a tree, but it
does not look like the Full little tree it shows at all..from others pictures i dont see a tree either.
On the back part there is basically nothing there.
Might look cute in a dressing room, bathroom, on a childs nightstand, on a tiny desk.

To say the least, I am disappointed.
Ill give this a 3 star for the effort someone has a job to do this ..
